plain.li: [theirs,a:plain,warmly] To {TO} and all at {COLONY}, warm greetings from {TOWN},
[theirs,a:plain,warmly] Dear {TO}, with all our good wishes,
[theirs,a:plain,warmly] {TO}, it is good to be writing to you again,
[theirs,a:plain,warmly,w:tribal] {TO}, whose words came to our fire,
[theirs,a:plain,warmly,w:tribal] To {TO} of {COLONY}, from the fires of {TOWN}, warmly,
[theirs,a:plain,warmly,w:spacer] {TO}, hello, and good to hear from you,
[theirs,a:plain,warmly,their:healers] To {TO}, in good health we hope, from the sickhouse at {TOWN},
[theirs,a:plain,warmly,their:pilgrims] To {TO}, a fellow traveller on the long road,
[theirs,a:plain,warmly,their:fishers] {TO}, greetings from the landing, where the river says hello too,
[theirs,a:plain,warmly,their:scholars] Dear {TO}, whose letters are filed here under Pleasant,
[theirs,a:plain,warmly,their:sextons] {TO}, the bell rings for the living too, and today it rings for you,
[theirs,a:plain,warmly,their:grovekeepers] {TO}, from under the old trees at {TOWN}, greetings that grow slowly but deep,
[theirs,a:plain,warmly,their:crew] {TO}, from the crew of {TOWN}, with fair winds,
[theirs,a:plain,warm|cordial,c:pious] {TO}, peace be with you and with all at {COLONY},
[theirs,a:plain,cordial,w:tribal] To {TO} of {COLONY}, greetings from the fires of {TOWN},
[theirs,a:plain,cordial,w:tribal] {TO}, the elders at {TOWN} send greetings, and so do I,
[theirs,a:plain,cordial,their:traders] To {TO} of {COLONY}, with the league's greetings,
[theirs,a:plain,cordial,their:citizens] To {TO}, citizen of {COLONY} in all but name,
[theirs,a:plain,cordial,their:linesmen] To {TO} at {COLONY}, greetings down the line,
[theirs,a:plain,cordial,c:loyal] To {TO} of {COLONY}, greetings in our leader's name,
[theirs,a:plain,cordial,c:together] To {TO} and the people of {COLONY}, from all of us at {TOWN} together,
[theirs,a:plain,cordial,m:trade] To {TO} of {COLONY}, with an eye to good business,
[theirs,a:plain,cordial|cool,m:trade] To {TO} of {COLONY}, from the traders' table at {TOWN},
[theirs,a:plain,cordial|cool,m:duty] To {TO}, in the matter of your letter to {TOWN},
[theirs,a:plain,cordial|cool,m:wary] To {TO} of {COLONY}, whom we know only by letter,
[theirs,a:plain,cordial|cool,m:proud] To {TO} of {COLONY}, from {TOWN}, which you will have heard of,
[theirs,a:plain,cordial|cool,m:proud] {TO} of {COLONY}, greetings from the first town of {PEOPLE},
[theirs,a:war] To {TO} of {COLONY}, under the white flag:
[theirs,a:war] To {COLONY}, from the other side of the war:
[theirs,a:war,warm|cordial] {TO}, and I do not know what else to call you while our peoples fight,
[theirs,a:war,warm|cordial] To {TO} of {COLONY}, enemy by our peoples' choosing and not by mine,
[theirs,a:war,w:tribal] To {COLONY}, from {TOWN}, where the war drums are not quiet:
[theirs,a:council] To {TO} and the people of {COLONY}, on behalf of {COUNCIL}:
[theirs,a:council,warm|cordial] To our neighbours at {COLONY}, greetings from {COUNCIL},
[theirs,a:council,w:tribal] To {COLONY}, from the elders who sat at the fire of {TOWN}:
[theirs,a:empire] To {TO} of {COLONY}, greetings, and the regard of the Empire,
[theirs,a:empire] To the people of {COLONY}, greetings, by the grace of the Empire,
[theirs,a:empire,warm|cordial] To {TO}, a friend to the Empire, greetings and honour,
[theirs,a:empire,warm|cordial] To {TO} of {COLONY}, whose courtesy does them honour,
[theirs,a:empire,cool] To {TO} of {COLONY}, by the Empire's leave,
[ours,a:plain,warmly,v:eloquent] To {TO} of {TOWN}, with every good wish,
[ours,a:plain,warmly,v:kind] Dear {TO}, I hope you are keeping well,
[ours,a:friend,warmly,v:eloquent] My dear {TO}, my most faithful correspondent,
[ours,a:war] To {TO} of {TOWN}, under a white flag,
[ours,a:war] To {TO}, across the war between us,
[ours,a:war,v:eloquent] To {TO} of {TOWN}, in the hope that a letter can cross where people cannot,
[ours,a:council] To the members of {COUNCIL}, greetings from {COLONY},
[ours,a:council,v:eloquent] To the honoured members of {COUNCIL}, greetings,
[ours,a:empire] To {TO}, {TOTITLE} of the Empire, the respects of {COLONY},
[ours,a:empire,v:eloquent] To {TO}, {TOTITLE}, whose honour is known even at {COLONY},
[theirs,olde,a:plain,warmly] My dear {TO}, well met by letter,
[theirs,olde,a:plain,warmly] To {TO} at {COLONY}, with the warmest greetings of {TOWN},
[theirs,olde,a:plain,warmly] Dear {TO}, whom I hold in high esteem,
[theirs,olde,a:plain,warmly] To mine own good {TO}, and to all who sit at thy table,
[theirs,olde,a:plain,warm|cordial,c:pious] {TO}, grace and peace be upon thee and upon {COLONY},
[theirs,olde,a:plain,cordial] To {TO} at {COLONY}, greeting and good health,
[theirs,olde,a:plain,cordial,their:healers] To {TO}, health and long days, from the sickhouse at {TOWN},
[theirs,olde,a:plain,cordial,their:pilgrims] To {TO}, a fellow walker upon the long road, greeting,
[theirs,olde,a:plain,cordial,their:artisans] To {TO} of {COLONY}, greeting from the guildhall at {TOWN},
[theirs,olde,a:plain,cordial|cool,m:trade] To {TO} of {COLONY}, greeting, and an honest bargain if thou wilt,
[theirs,olde,a:plain,cordial|cool,m:duty] To {TO} of {COLONY}, on behalf of {TOWN}, greeting,
[theirs,olde,a:plain,cordial|cool,m:wary] To {TO} of {COLONY}, whom I know but by thy letter,
[theirs,olde,a:plain,cordial|cool,m:proud] To {TO} of {COLONY}, from {TOWN}, whereof thou hast surely heard,
[theirs,olde,a:friend,warmly] Dearest {TO}, of all who write to me the most welcome,
[theirs,olde,a:war] To {TO} of {COLONY}, under the white flag, these,
[theirs,olde,a:war] Unto {COLONY}, from the far side of the war,
[theirs,olde,a:war,warm|cordial] {TO}, whom I must call foe, though my heart is loath to,
[theirs,olde,a:council] To the folk of {COLONY}, from {COUNCIL}, greeting:
[theirs,olde,a:council] Unto {TO} and the folk of {COLONY}, on behalf of {COUNCIL}:
[theirs,olde,a:council,warm|cordial] To our good neighbours at {COLONY}, {COUNCIL} sendeth greeting,
[ours,olde,a:plain,warmly,v:eloquent] Most dear {TO}, whom we of {COLONY} hold in great affection,
[ours,olde,a:plain,warmly,v:kind] Good {TO}, I trust this findeth thee well,
[ours,olde,a:war] To {TO} of {TOWN}, under a white flag,
[ours,olde,a:war] Unto {TO}, across the war that lieth between us,
[ours,olde,a:council] Unto the worthy members of {COUNCIL}, greeting from {COLONY},
[u:some,warmly] Dear {TO}, hello from {TOWN} and evryone here,
[theirs,u:some,cordial|cool] To {TO} of {COLONY}, in anser to yor letter,
[theirs,u:some,warm|cordial,a:war] To {TO} of {COLONY}, under the wite flag,
[theirs,u:none,cordial|cool] to {TO} of {COLONY} or hoever reads it
[theirs,u:none,curt|refusal,c:raider] to the walls at {COLONY} and the cowards behind them
[ours,u:some,cordial|cool] To {TO} of {TOWN}, gretings from all of us,
[ours,u:none,warmly] deer {TO} hello from all of us
[theirs,sv:beast,warm|cordial] {TO} of {COLONY}, good hunting to your den,
[sv:beast,cordial|cool] {TO}. We have your letter, and the smell of your road on it.
[sv:green,warmly] {TO}, may the light find you early and leave you late,
[theirs,sv:green,warm|cordial] {TO} of {COLONY}, greetings, slowly, as all good greetings grow,
[sv:green,cool|curt] {TO}. The season is short. So is this.
[sv:fey,warmly] By leaf and by string, by the third hour of dew: greetings, {TO}, and gladly.
[sv:fey,warm|cordial] By leaf and by string, by the third hour of dew: greetings, {TO}.
[sv:fey,cordial|cool] By leaf and by string: {TO}, hear us.
[sv:fey,cool|curt] By leaf and by string, and no further: {TO}.
[theirs,sv:ancient,warmly] To {TO}, of the settlement styled {COLONY}, from {FROM}, with a regard I find, to my surprise, entirely sincere:
[theirs,sv:ancient,warm|cordial] To {TO}, of the settlement styled {COLONY}, from {FROM}, at {TOWN}: greetings in the proper form.
[theirs,sv:ancient,cordial|cool] To the person {TO}, presently resident at {COLONY}: greetings, as custom requires.
[theirs,sv:ancient,cool|curt] To {TO}, of {COLONY}. Greetings are customary. Consider them given.
[theirs,sv:ancient,curt|refusal] To {COLONY}, which has written to me. Once.
[sv:deep,warmly] {TO}. Warm, the hand that writes you. Strange that it is so.
[sv:deep,warm|cordial] {TO}. Greeted, you are. By what greets, ask not.
[theirs,sv:deep,cordial|cool] {TO} of {COLONY}. Read, we have. Answer, we do.
